hypothesis_origin: Generated by the frozen MAPPPD observation that all three increasing regional Pygoscelis networks ended with lower effective breeding-site number; this SMP contract is an independent test and does not reinterpret MAPPPD as confirmatory evidence.

state_variables.N_it: annual total breeding abundance in frozen species x MasterSite panel i
state_variables.E_it: inverse-Simpson effective number of retained SiteID components, 1/sum_j(p_ijt^2)
state_variables.b_i: OLS slope of log1p(N_it) on centered year
state_variables.gamma_obs_i: OLS slope of log(E_it) on centered year

fixed_composition_null.q_ij: pooled count share of retained component j across all complete years in panel i
preserve: exact empirical annual panel totals N_it
fixed_composition_null.simulate: For integer count units, draw multinomial(N_it, q_i). If the retained SMP unit is not integer-valued, stop and freeze a unit-specific null before computing concentration outcomes rather than silently rounding.
fixed_composition_null.observation_error: Primary null uses raw observed counts only. Estimated/hidden-estimate records are excluded by the structural contract. No post-outcome error model is added.

interpretation.negative: excess temporal concentration beyond the exact abundance trajectory under fixed composition

primary_macro_model.formula: delta_gamma_i = alpha + beta * z(b_i) + species_random_intercept + error_i
primary_macro_model.uncertainty: parametric hierarchical model plus species-cluster bootstrap with 9999 resamples as mandatory robustness

focal_parameters.alpha: mean excess concentration at mean standardized abundance trend
focal_parameters.beta: coupling between abundance trend and excess temporal concentration

primary_macro_model.expected_decline_coupling_direction: beta > 0 because more negative b should correspond to more negative delta_gamma if decline drives concentration

secondary_trend_class_contrast.increasing_mean: mu_plus = mean/model-estimated delta_gamma among b_i > 0 panels
secondary_trend_class_contrast.declining_mean: mu_minus = mean/model-estimated delta_gamma among b_i < 0 panels
secondary_trend_class_contrast.inference: prespecified secondary contrast; no post-hoc trend threshold

outcome_patterns.reversible_tracking: mu_minus < 0 and mu_plus > 0 with uncertainty excluding zero in their respective directions
outcome_patterns.decline_specific: mu_minus < 0 while mu_plus is not supported as negative
outcome_patterns.directional_persistence: both mu_minus < 0 and mu_plus < 0 with one-sided support in both groups

secondary_trend_class_contrast.terminology: If both groups are negative, call this directionally persistent or ratchet-compatible concentration, not hysteresis.

boundaries: E is effective monitored-component number, not occupied area.
Species x MasterSite is a monitoring network, not assumed demographically closed.
Do not use kappa as the primary symmetry estimand because its sign changes when abundance trend changes.
Do not claim hysteresis from cross-panel symmetry alone.
Do not search traits, thresholds, lags, nonlinear trend classes, or alternative MasterSite/component definitions after delta_gamma is opened.
stop_rule: One execution after both structural and trend-balance gates pass. If the symmetry gate fails, this contract remains unexecuted.
